headline: Video: Dissecting Reform to Face “Threat” of RI Downgraded to Standalone Market
summary: A discussion of Indonesia's stock market reforms addresses the risk of MSCI removing Indonesia from its emerging market index and reclassifying it as a standalone market. The input gives no further details.
why: MSCI index classifications determine how much passive and institutional capital tracks a market, so a downgrade can trigger outflows.
original_headline: Video: Bedah Reformasi Hadapi "Ancaman" RI Turun ke Standalone Market
